events.title: Z.ai launches GLM-5.4 with a looped 750B architecture
events.title_zh: Z.ai 推出采用循环架构的 GLM-5.4
events.summary: Z.ai launched GLM-5.4, its first flagship Loop Transformer. The model runs 28 shared middle layers twice on a roughly 750B-parameter base and exposes a 1M context window in coding products. It is available through every GLM Coding Plan tier, ZCode and Z.ai Chat, while the standard API is still coming soon and open weights await safety hardening.
events.summary_en: Z.ai launched GLM-5.4, its first flagship Loop Transformer. The model runs 28 shared middle layers twice on a roughly 750B-parameter base and exposes a 1M context window in coding products. It is available through every GLM Coding Plan tier, ZCode and Z.ai Chat, while the standard API is still coming soon and open weights await safety hardening.
events.summary_zh: Z.ai 推出首个旗舰 Loop Transformer GLM-5.4。模型在约 750B 参数底座上把 28 个共享中间层运行两遍，并在编码产品中提供 1M 上下文。所有 GLM Coding Plan 档位、ZCode 与 Z.ai Chat 已可使用，但标准 API 尚未开放，权重也要等安全加固完成。
events.why_it_matters: Looped depth may improve reasoning without duplicating every parameter, but engineering teams cannot independently test serving cost or claims until an API or weights arrive.
events.why_it_matters_en: Looped depth may improve reasoning without duplicating every parameter, but engineering teams cannot independently test serving cost or claims until an API or weights arrive.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对模型与编码 agent 团队来说，循环深度可能在不复制全部参数的情况下增加推理计算；但 API 或权重开放前，无法独立验证服务成本和能力主张。

technical_details.architecture: Loop Transformer; 28 shared layers executed twice
technical_details.availability: GLM Coding Plan Lite, Pro, Max and Team; ZCode; Z.ai Chat
technical_details.vendor_limit: Benchmarks and throughput are vendor-reported; vendor notes marathon-thinking loops
technical_details.time_basis: Official launch provides 2026-11-23 without a publication hour.

technical_details_zh.架构: Loop Transformer；28 个共享层运行两遍
technical_details_zh.可用范围: GLM Coding Plan Lite、Pro、Max、团队版；ZCode；Z.ai Chat
technical_details_zh.开放权重: 完成安全加固后计划开放
technical_details_zh.证据边界: benchmark 与吞吐来自厂商；厂商承认可能陷入过长思考循环
technical_details_zh.时间依据: 官方只提供 2026-11-23，没有发布时间。

events.next_action_zh: 等标准 API 或开放权重上线后，再用固定代码任务比较循环架构的质量、延迟、token 消耗和长上下文稳定性。
events.next_action_en: Reassess after API or weight access, comparing quality, latency, token use and long-context stability on fixed coding tasks.

evidence.claim_zh: Z.ai 官方资料确认产品内可用、1M 上下文，以及 API 与权重尚未开放。
evidence.claim_en: Z.ai material confirms product availability, 1M context, and that API and weights are not yet available.
evidence.verification: verified official launch and availability documentation

changes.summary_zh: GLM-5.4 在订阅与聊天产品中开放，API 与权重仍未提供。
changes.summary_en: GLM-5.4 launches in subscription and chat products while API and weights remain unavailable.

events.title: Tencent opens WeMM-Ecom weights for local multimodal commerce tasks
events.title_zh: Tencent 开放 WeMM-Ecom 本地多模态电商权重
events.summary: Tencent populated WeMM-Ecom weights in five sizes from 0.8B through 35B-A3B and released GGUF and GPTQ variants. The Apache-2.0 family handles text, images, multiple images and video with a 262K context window. Tencent reports results on 28 commerce and 64 general benchmarks, but no independent reproduction is available.
events.summary_en: Tencent populated WeMM-Ecom weights in five sizes from 0.8B through 35B-A3B and released GGUF and GPTQ variants. The Apache-2.0 family handles text, images, multiple images and video with a 262K context window. Tencent reports results on 28 commerce and 64 general benchmarks, but no independent reproduction is available.
events.summary_zh: Tencent 为 WeMM-Ecom 上传了从 0.8B 到 35B-A3B 的五种规模权重，并提供 GGUF 与 GPTQ 版本。Apache-2.0 模型支持文本、单图、多图和视频，标称上下文为 262K。Tencent 报告覆盖 28 项电商与 64 项通用 benchmark，但尚无独立复现。
events.why_it_matters: Teams building catalog OCR, attribute extraction, moderation or product understanding can now test a specialized multimodal family locally instead of relying only on a hosted service.
events.why_it_matters_en: Teams building catalog OCR, attribute extraction, moderation or product understanding can now test a specialized multimodal family locally instead of relying only on a hosted service.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对做商品 OCR、属性提取、审核或商品理解的团队来说，现在可以在本地测试专用多模态模型，而不是只依赖托管服务。

technical_details.formats: BF16, FP8, GPTQ W4A16, GGUF Q4_K_M
technical_details.serving: Transformers >=5.2, vLLM and SGLang; GGUF uses llama.cpp
technical_details.evaluation: Vendor reports 28 e-commerce benchmarks across eight scenarios and 64 general benchmarks across eight categories
technical_details.availability_time: Base weights uploaded 2026-11-23T09:59:17Z; GGUF repos 02:01-02:02Z; GPTQ repos 06:04-06:05Z

evidence.claim_en: Hugging Face repositories confirm downloadable base, GGUF and GPTQ weights with local serving recipes.

changes.summary_zh: WeMM-Ecom 五种规模的基础与量化权重已经可以下载和本地服务。
changes.summary_en: WeMM-Ecom base and quantized weights across five sizes become downloadable and locally servable.

events.title: OpenAI and Cisco open-source Shirudo for live Linux mitigations
events.title_zh: OpenAI 与 Cisco 开源 Linux 在线缓解工具 Shirudo
events.summary: OpenAI and Cisco released Shirudo, a pre-release open-source runtime for signed eBPF and Java mitigations on running Linux systems. Operators can monitor, approve, load and attest temporary shields while permanent patches are prepared. Production use needs kernel changes and TPM 2.0.
events.summary_en: OpenAI and Cisco released Shirudo, a pre-release open-source runtime for signed eBPF and Java mitigations on running Linux systems. Operators can monitor, approve, load and attest temporary shields while permanent patches are prepared. Production use needs kernel changes and TPM 2.0.
events.summary_zh: OpenAI 与 Cisco 发布 Shirudo：一个处于 pre-release 的开源运行时，可在运行中的 Linux 系统加载签名 eBPF 与 Java 临时缓解措施。运维人员可以先观察、审批，再加载和验证 shield；正式补丁仍需继续部署。生产使用要求内核改动和 TPM 2.0。
events.why_it_matters: Security teams gain a testable bridge between disclosure and patch rollout, but a privileged live-mitigation layer can create new failure modes and is not production-ready.
events.why_it_matters_en: Security teams gain a testable bridge between disclosure and patch rollout, but a privileged live-mitigation layer can create new failure modes and is not production-ready.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对安全与基础设施团队来说，它提供了漏洞披露到正式补丁之间可测试的缓冲层；但高权限在线缓解本身也会引入新的故障模式，目前不适合直接生产采用。

technical_details.mechanism: Signed eBPF and Java upatches with monitor-before-enforce workflow
technical_details.production_requirements: Patched Linux kernel with signed-loader ABI and TPM 2.0
technical_details.evidence_limit: Java4Shell result is a controlled publisher/partner test, not independent production evidence

technical_details_zh.机制: 签名 eBPF 与 Java upatch；支持先观察后执行
technical_details_zh.验证: TPM 记录并支持离线核验
technical_details_zh.许可: BSD-2-Clause；BPF 程序为 BSD/GPL 双许可
technical_details_zh.生产要求: 带 signed-loader ABI 的补丁内核与 TPM 2.0
technical_details_zh.证据限制: Java4Shell 结果来自发布方与合作方受控测试，不是独立生产证据

events.next_action_zh: 一天内只在隔离 VM 按 quickstart 验证签名、观察模式、加载、回滚和 TPM 证据；不要接入生产主机。
events.next_action_en: Within one day, use only an isolated VM to verify signing, observe mode, load, rollback and TPM evidence; do not attach it to production hosts.

evidence.claim_zh: 官方公告、仓库和 quickstart 确认 Shirudo 已开源但仍为 pre-release。
evidence.claim_en: The announcement, repository and quickstart confirm Shirudo is open source but pre-release.
evidence.verification: verified public code and documentation; efficacy remains publisher-run

changes.summary_zh: Shirudo 开源并提供隔离 VM 的在线缓解验证路径。
changes.summary_en: Shirudo opens with an isolated-VM path for testing live mitigations.

events.title: Ai2 releases RoboTrack to test point tracking in real manipulation
events.title_zh: Ai2 发布 RoboTrack 检验真实操作中的点追踪
events.summary: Ai2 released RoboTrack-Bench, RoboTrack-15M, training and evaluation code, and two point-tracking checkpoints for robot manipulation. The benchmark contains 307 real videos and 2,522 human-verified tracks; the synthetic training set contains 15 million tracks. Publisher tests show modest gains, while the strongest checkpoint is non-commercial.
events.summary_en: Ai2 released RoboTrack-Bench, RoboTrack-15M, training and evaluation code, and two point-tracking checkpoints for robot manipulation. The benchmark contains 307 real videos and 2,522 human-verified tracks; the synthetic training set contains 15 million tracks. Publisher tests show modest gains, while the strongest checkpoint is non-commercial.
events.summary_zh: Ai2 发布 RoboTrack-Bench、RoboTrack-15M、训练与评测代码，以及两个机器人操作点追踪 checkpoint。benchmark 包含 307 段真实视频和 2,522 条人工核验轨迹；合成训练集包含 1,500 万条轨迹。发布方测试显示有限提升，最强 checkpoint 仅限非商业用途。
events.why_it_matters: Robotics teams can now test trackers against clutter, occlusion and viewpoint changes in real manipulation footage instead of relying on easier benchmarks.
events.why_it_matters_en: Robotics teams can now test trackers against clutter, occlusion and viewpoint changes in real manipulation footage instead of relying on easier benchmarks.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对机器人团队来说，可以在真实操作视频的遮挡、杂乱背景和视角变化下检验 tracker，不再只依赖更容易的 benchmark。

technical_details.training_data: RoboTrack-15M: 3,000 simulated videos and 15 million tracks
technical_details.artifacts: Code, data, RoboTracker and RoboTracker-Warp checkpoints
technical_details.licenses: RoboTracker Apache-2.0; RoboTracker-Warp CC-BY-NC-4.0; dataset components have separate terms
technical_details.publisher_result: RoboTracker-Warp 65.98 AJ versus 63.87 for publisher CoWTracker baseline
technical_details.safety_limit: Long occlusion and textureless surfaces remain failure cases; do not directly drive robot motion without bounded control
technical_details.time_basis: Official release has date-only precision; initial GitHub commit predates checkpoint, while benchmark modification was in-window

technical_details_zh.benchmark: 307 段视频、2,522 条人工核验轨迹
technical_details_zh.训练数据: RoboTrack-15M：3,000 段合成视频、1,500 万条轨迹
technical_details_zh.公开工件: 代码、数据、RoboTracker 与 RoboTracker-Warp checkpoint
technical_details_zh.许可: RoboTracker 为 Apache-2.0；RoboTracker-Warp 为 CC-BY-NC-4.0；数据组件各有条款
technical_details_zh.发布方结果: RoboTracker-Warp 为 65.98 AJ，发布方 CoWTracker baseline 为 63.87
technical_details_zh.安全限制: 长遮挡与无纹理表面仍会失败；没有受限控制时不能直接驱动机器人
technical_details_zh.时间依据: 官方仅给日期；GitHub 初始提交早于 checkpoint，benchmark 修改发生在窗口内

events.next_action_zh: 一天内用公开 checkpoint 跑一小段 RoboTrack-Bench 和自有遮挡视频，记录 AJ、失败类型、速度与许可边界。
events.next_action_en: Within one day, run public checkpoints on a RoboTrack-Bench slice and your occlusion videos, recording AJ, failure modes, speed and license limits.

evidence.claim_zh: 代码、数据与 checkpoint 已公开；性能和机器人试验结果仍来自发布方。
evidence.claim_en: Code, data and checkpoints are public; performance and robot trials remain publisher-run.
evidence.verification: verified artifacts; results not independently reproduced

changes.summary_zh: RoboTrack 公开真实操作 benchmark、合成训练集和两个 tracker。
changes.summary_en: RoboTrack opens a real-manipulation benchmark, synthetic training set and two trackers.

events.title: Google adds server-side file slicing to the Gemini API
events.title_zh: Google 为 Gemini API 加入服务端文件切片
events.summary: Google added native server-side slicing for PDFs, Office and OpenDocument files, spreadsheets, audio and video in the Gemini API. Developers can select pages, cells, time ranges, layers and resolution while reusing uploaded files. The feature is available across Gemini 4 models and bills only inspected content.
events.summary_en: Google added native server-side slicing for PDFs, Office and OpenDocument files, spreadsheets, audio and video in the Gemini API. Developers can select pages, cells, time ranges, layers and resolution while reusing uploaded files. The feature is available across Gemini 4 models and bills only inspected content.
events.summary_zh: Google 为 Gemini API 加入原生服务端切片，覆盖 PDF、Office 与 OpenDocument 文件、电子表格、音频和视频。开发者可以复用上传文件，只指定页码、单元格、时间区间、内容层与分辨率。该能力支持全部 Gemini 4 模型，只对实际检查的内容计费。
events.why_it_matters: Multimodal RAG and agent teams can reduce local conversion code and token waste, but vendor savings vary with document layout and must be measured on retained workloads.
events.why_it_matters_en: Multimodal RAG and agent teams can reduce local conversion code and token waste, but vendor savings vary with document layout and must be measured on retained workloads.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对多模态 RAG 与 agent 团队来说，可以减少本地格式转换和无效 token；但节省幅度受文档布局影响，必须用保留任务测量。

technical_details.availability: Available in Google AI Studio and Gemini for business across Gemini 4 models

technical_details.spreadsheets: Sheet index, visible cell range, values/formulas/visuals
technical_details.media: Audio/video time ranges; video frame rate and resolution
technical_details.billing: Tokens charged for inspected slices rather than the full file
technical_details.publisher_results: Vercel reports 14x fewer tokens on one PDF flow; LiteLLM reports 67% PDF and 33% workbook reductions
technical_details.time_basis: Page metadata gives 2026-11-23T16:12:00Z, inside overlap but before the previous checkpoint

technical_details_zh.可用范围: Google AI Studio 与 Gemini for business；支持全部 Gemini 4 模型
technical_details_zh.文档: 页码范围、文本/图像层、低/中/高分辨率
technical_details_zh.电子表格: 工作表索引、可见单元格范围、数值/公式/视觉层
technical_details_zh.媒体: 音频/视频时间区间；视频帧率与分辨率
technical_details_zh.计费: 按实际检查的切片计 token，不按完整文件
technical_details_zh.发布方结果: Vercel 报告一条 PDF 流程 token 减少 14 倍；LiteLLM 报告 PDF 减少 67%、工作簿减少 33%
technical_details_zh.时间依据: 页面元数据为 2026-11-23T16:12:00Z，处于 overlap 且早于上次 checkpoint

events.next_action_en: Within one day, compare full and sliced input across 20 PDFs, workbooks and videos for recall, tokens, latency, errors and local-processing cost.

evidence.claim_zh: Google 官方页面确认切片范围、可用模型与按实际内容计费。
evidence.claim_en: Google confirms slicing scope, model availability and billing for inspected content.
evidence.verification: verified official availability; partner savings not independently reproduced

changes.summary_zh: Gemini API 开放服务端文档与媒体切片。
changes.summary_en: Gemini API opens server-side document and media slicing.

events.title: InclusionAI releases Ling-3.2-air for local multimodal automation
events.title_zh: InclusionAI 开放多模态自动化模型 Ling-3.2-air
events.summary: InclusionAI released Ling-3.2-air, a MIT-licensed multimodal MoE with 124B total and 5.5B active parameters. Public weights support text, images, video, tool calling and up to 256K context through documented SGLang and vLLM recipes. The model requires four 141GB-class GPUs or eight 80GB GPUs in the publisher recipes, and benchmark gains remain publisher-reported.
events.summary_en: InclusionAI released Ling-3.2-air, a MIT-licensed multimodal MoE with 124B total and 5.5B active parameters. Public weights support text, images, video, tool calling and up to 256K context through documented SGLang and vLLM recipes. The model requires four 141GB-class GPUs or eight 80GB GPUs in the publisher recipes, and benchmark gains remain publisher-reported.
events.summary_zh: InclusionAI 发布 Ling-3.2-air：一个 MIT 许可的多模态 MoE，总参数 124B、每 token 激活 5.5B。公开权重支持文本、图片、视频、工具调用和最长 256K 上下文，并提供 SGLang 与 vLLM 配方。发布方配方需要 4 张 141GB 级 GPU 或 8 张 80GB GPU，benchmark 提升尚无独立复现。
events.why_it_matters: Teams evaluating self-hosted multimodal agents get a testable model aimed at document reasoning and workflow automation, but its memory floor makes deployment a server-cluster decision rather than a workstation experiment.
events.why_it_matters_en: Teams evaluating self-hosted multimodal agents get a testable model aimed at document reasoning and workflow automation, but its memory floor makes deployment a server-cluster decision rather than a workstation experiment.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对评估自托管多模态 agent 的团队来说，这是一个可验证的文档推理与工作流自动化模型；但显存门槛很高，部署更接近服务器集群决策，而非工作站试验。

technical_details.architecture: Hybrid-linear MoE; 124B total, 5.5B active; 512 routed experts and 8 active experts
technical_details.modalities: Text, images and video input; text output; reasoning and tool calling
technical_details.deployment: SGLang day-0 image and a dedicated vLLM fork; trust_remote_code required

technical_details.availability: MIT weights on Hugging Face; no hosted inference provider listed
